title: Irish Crumble Cake
description: A moist and crumbly Irish-inspired cake that combines the flavors of velvety and nut.
instructions: Grease a 9-inch round cake pan and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, followed by Irish cream.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared cake pan and smooth top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
While cake is baking, prepare Irish crumble mix according to package instructions.
Remove cake from oven and top with crumble mixture.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes or until crumble is golden brown.
